text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer make predictions about new information. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. After training, we test the model to see how accurate it is. Accuracy measures how often the model's predictions are correct. The better the training data, the more accurate the predictions will be.
